jobs.description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

About The Team

Launched in 2021, Fanatics Betting and Gaming is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics, a global digital sports platform. The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin.

As Director of Engineering for iCasino Experiences at Fanatics Betting and Gaming, you lead the engineering organization that builds the technology customers interact with in one of the fastest-growing online casinos in the U.S. Your teams design, build, and operate the software behind the casino experience across multiple customer-facing mobile applications, backed end-to-end by the content management systems and personalization that power every surface.

You'll lead an organization of roughly 20 full-time engineers spanning the U.S. and the U.K. This organization has built a product that industry analysts rank among the very best in the market for user experience, with a reliability record to match — and your mandate is to keep raising that bar while closing the competitive gap to the largest operators in the space.

This is a role that blends strategic and operational leadership. You'll set the delivery direction and quality standards your engineering managers run their teams against, shape the technical roadmap in close partnership with Product, Design, and TPM, and represent iCasino in cross-company programs — architectural, delivery, and people-related. You are customer-obsessed, and you know how to translate that obsession into an organization that ships fast and constantly evolves.

Responsibilities

Lead a high-performing engineering organization across the U.S. and the U.K.
Own delivery across the domain — set the operating rhythm, hold teams to commitments, proactively surface and resolve cross-team delivery risks, and keep capacity allocation transparent to Product and business stakeholders
Own the engineering quality and reliability bar for all customer-facing casino applications, including production readiness standards, observability, test automation strategy, and incident response across the domain
Partner with Product, Design, and TPM leadership to shape the roadmap, drive iterative delivery with intentionally scoped V1s, and translate company-level experience priorities into the domain's execution plan
Hire, develop, and coach engineering managers and senior individual contributors; design the org structure and talent strategy needed to meet business goals
Represent iCasino Experiences in cross-organization programs spanning architecture, delivery, and people — driving alignment while keeping Casino's needs front and center
Champion improvements to engineering practices, planning processes, and operational maturity that scale beyond your own domain
Step into ambiguous, cross-team problems that lack a clear owner, structure the work, and lead it to resolution
Be open to occasional travel to Fanatics offices and other locations for conferences, events, meetings, and team-building activities

Experience And Skills

10+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years leading engineering teams through managers, ideally across multiple geographies and time zones
Proven ownership of consumer-facing product experiences at scale — you have led organizations building mobile products where speed, polish, and reliability are the differentiators
Strong delivery leadership, with a track record of running predictable execution across multiple teams, managing risk proactively, and holding a high quality bar without sacrificing velocity
Demonstrated ability to build and scale engineering organizations — hiring and developing engineering teams, designing team structures aligned to business needs, and making hard performance calls with clarity and fairness
Deep operational rigor — experience owning production reliability for customer-facing systems, including observability, on-call structures, incident management, and post-incident improvement
Strong technical judgment across modern client and backend architectures — able to guide architectural decisions, evaluate platform bets, and resolve cross-team technical risks without being in the code every day
Comfort leading distributed teams across time zones

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in online gaming or other highly regulated industries, including familiarity with certification and compliance processes
Experience leading teams building high-end mobile applications, and with content management or personalization systems
Track record of driving cross-organization initiatives — planning process redesigns, platform migrations, or automation programs adopted beyond your own teams
Background in startups or high-growth environments where products went from zero to market-leading

Ready to build the future of sports betting? If you possess some of these skills but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply!

jobs.description:
Novelis is one of the world leaders in aluminum recycling and rolling and a leading sustainable aluminum solutions provider. Driven by our purpose of shaping a sustainable world together, we work alongside our customers to provide innovative solutions to the aerospace, automotive, beverage packaging and specialty markets. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Novelis has approximately 13,000 employees in 32 operating facilities on 4 continents.

Responsibilities & Qualifications

The Novelis North America team is seeking a Director, Engineering & Operations Support to build and lead a brand-new organization from the ground up. As Director, Engineering & Operations Support, you will report to the Senior Vice President, Operations, North America, and lead a talented team of senior engineers, with the Manager, Quality and Manager, Engineering & Reliability reporting directly to this role. You will provide regional leadership for strategic engineering projects, reliability and maintenance, and quality systems and processes across our North American manufacturing plants — shaping the function's direction and playing a pivotal role in achieving our operational and financial targets. We are looking for a highly experienced, hands-on leader who thrives on the challenge of standing up a new team and is energized by the opportunity to leave a lasting mark on our organization.

Responsibilities

Build and lead a new, centralized engineering, reliability, maintenance, and quality organization — supporting manufacturing plants, customers, and tolling operations across North America.
Ensure projects and technical activities align with environmental, health, and safety requirements, engineering controls, regulatory obligations, and management-of-change expectations.
Establish a transparent process to assess, prioritize, and deploy technical resources based on safety, customer impact, operational risk, business value, and regional priorities.
Provide governance and technical oversight for feasibility studies, front-end engineering, project development, execution, commissioning, startup, and operational ramp-up.
Lead the resolution of significant plant and tolling quality issues through structured root-cause analysis, stronger controls, consistent practices, and prevention of recurrence.
Advance reliability and asset performance through equipment strategy, failure elimination, preventive and predictive maintenance, outage support, and disciplined technical problem solving.
Develop technical talent, strengthen standards and knowledge transfer, align multi-functional collaborators, and communicate recommendations, portfolio updates, and material risks to senior leaders.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering.
15 or more years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing engineering, quality, reliability, maintenance, capital projects, or a closely related operations rigor.
Experience leading managers and multidisciplinary technical teams in a multi-site, matrixed manufacturing environment.
Experience with project governance, feasibility and front-end engineering, capital justification, supplier management, and safe project execution.
Broad knowledge of reliability fundamentals, rolling process fundamentals, advanced engineering and diagnostic analysis, and financial analysis for project return on investment.
Strong engineering judgment, systems thinking, prioritization, and the ability to influence, negotiate, and align senior partners across organizational boundaries.
Demonstrated experience leading organizational change, including standing up, restructuring, or scaling a new function or team.
Proven experience directly managing other managers or leaders, in addition to broader technical teams.
Working knowledge of quality management systems and methodologies (e.g., ISO 9001, Six Sigma, root-cause/CAPA analysis).
Proven ability to communicate with, present to, and influence executive leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree (MBA or Master's in Engineering).
Operational leadership experience.
Experience managing complex projects and capital expenditure budgets.
Experience in aluminum or rolled/cast metal production, heavy industrial, automotive, or continuous-process manufacturing.
Six Sigma or Lean certification (e.g., Black Belt).
Track record of building or reorganizing engineering and/or quality functions.

jobs.description:
Drive delivery and operational excellence.

Millennium is seeking a Director of Engineering.
As the operational leader for the Engineering Business Unit, the Director of Engineering holds end-to-end accountability for delivery execution, unit economics, and operational scaling. Partnering directly with the VP of Strategic Solutions in a balanced commercial/operational dynamic, this role owns the business unit's operational and financial performance—driving gross margin, EBITDA, cost structure, resource allocation, and talent development. While the commercial organization focuses on revenue growth and market strategy, the Director of Engineering ensures that delivery operations excel in precision, efficiency, client retention, and long-term profitability.

What You'll Do

Own gross margin and EBITDA performance for the Engineering Business Unit
Own annual budget, forecasting, and staffing plans for the unit, translating project-level staffing input from the Head of Strategic Engineering and Engineering Manager(s) into a unit-wide plan.
Own cost structures and delivery economics, working with the VP where these connect to client-facing rate cards.
Design and monitor the unit's departmental KPIs — backlog strength, on-time delivery, unit cost per fiber-kilometer (KFM), margin by project — reported through NetSuite/Domo, with the Head of Strategic Engineering responsible for producing the underlying measures.
Own backlog, workload forecasting, and resource allocation across projects, with the Head of Strategic Engineering responsible for day-to-day backlog and workload monitoring, and Engineering Manager(s) consulted.
Own client retention — relationship health and proactive response to client needs — with the Head of Strategic Engineering responsible for day-to-day relationship management.
Own tool and technology evaluation and recommendation for the unit, incorporating Engineering Manager(s) input as it matures.
Own monthly reporting to management on status, performance, and metrics, with the Head of Strategic Engineering and Engineering Manager(s) responsible for generating the underlying reports.
Own succession planning and leadership development pipeline, including senior engineer training and technical development.
Partner with the VP on strategic planning and provide input on client retention risk that touches sales-facing accounts.

What You Bring

10+ years in telecom, fiber/broadband infrastructure, or a comparable capital-project environment, including direct accountability for a unit's margin, budget, and cost structure.
Direct experience coordinating OSP engineering, design, and permitting workflows with major national carriers (e.g., AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile).
Demonstrated experience owning KPI design and monthly management reporting for an operating unit.
Fluency with ERP/BI tools (NetSuite, Domo, or equivalent) and comfort presenting financial and delivery performance to executive and Board audiences.
Experience building and developing a leadership bench (director- and manager-level) and running succession planning.
Comfort operating as a peer to a commercially-focused VP without overlapping accountability

Why Join Millennium?

Millennium helps our clients to build broadband networks to connect communities across America. But we're more than that - we offer our clients enterprise resources to plan out their builds, supplement their funding, manage their materials, and get the equipment they need to get networks up and running.
A collaborative work environment where you can influence the overall success of the company through your efforts and expertise. The growth mode we operate in provides tremendous opportunities for your career path and personal development.

Building Envelope- Forensic Engineering & Litigation Support

Florida

Ready to play a leading role in developing a specialized forensic engineering practice and solving some of the most complex challenges affecting Florida’s built environment? If you are an experienced engineer who combines technical expertise, investigative thinking, sound professional judgment, and the ability to clearly communicate complex findings, we would welcome the opportunity to speak with you.

Pinchin makes buildings and environments better. We are a multidisciplinary engineering and consulting firm with offices across North America. Our teams bring together expertise in environmental services, building science and resiliency, occupational health and safety, sustainability, and engineering to help clients make informed decisions and achieve better outcomes.

Pinchin is seeking a Director of Forensic Engineering
to join our Florida Forensic Engineering & Litigation Support
practice.

The Director of Forensic Engineering will serve as a senior technical leader within the Florida practice, working under the leadership of the Senior Directors to provide independent forensic investigations, failure analysis, litigation support, and expert witness services. This individual will also play an important role in developing our forensic capabilities, mentoring technical professionals, strengthening relationships within the legal and insurance communities, and supporting the continued growth of the practice.

Building Envelope- Forensic Engineering Overview

Pinchin’s Forensic Engineering & Litigation Support practice provides independent, objective technical analysis
to attorneys, insurers, property owners, community associations, and other stakeholders involved in complex building failures, insurance claims, and construction-related disputes.

Our work includes forensic investigations, root cause and failure analysis, construction defect evaluations, building envelope and water intrusion investigations, standard-of-care assessments, causation and damage analysis, destructive and non-destructive testing, expert reports, deposition support, and expert testimony.

The Director of Forensic Engineering will help strengthen and expand these capabilities throughout Florida while collaborating with Pinchin professionals across disciplines and geographic locations.

Your Impact as a Director of Forensic Engineering

As a Director of Forensic Engineering, you will combine advanced technical expertise, investigative judgment, expert communication, people leadership, and client stewardship
to lead complex forensic assignments and help develop Pinchin’s Florida forensic practice.

Lead complex forensic engineering investigations, failure analyses, construction defect evaluations, and insurance claim assignments involving existing buildings and related systems.
Develop technically sound and defensible opinions regarding cause, origin, extent of damage, standard of care, repair considerations, and other engineering issues within your areas of expertise.
Plan and oversee field investigations, destructive and non-destructive testing, document review, evidence documentation, technical analysis, and multidisciplinary investigations.
Prepare and review forensic engineering reports, expert opinions, technical memoranda, exhibits, and other litigation-related deliverables.
Provide litigation support and expert witness services, including consultation with legal counsel, mediation support, deposition preparation and testimony, and trial testimony.
Serve as a trusted technical advisor to attorneys, insurers, associations, property owners, and other clients while maintaining professional independence and objectivity.
Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and quality oversight for engineers and other professionals supporting forensic assignments.
Support the continued growth of Pinchin’s forensic practice through client development, industry relationships, strategic pursuits, recruiting, and development of internal technical capabilities.
Collaborate across Pinchin offices and disciplines to assemble the appropriate expertise for complex assignments while promoting a One Pinchin approach to client service and technical delivery.
Maintain high standards for technical quality, responsiveness, professional ethics, financial performance, and defensibility of engineering opinions.

What You'll Bring To Pinchin

The successful candidate will bring a combination of advanced engineering expertise, forensic investigation experience, sound professional judgment, leadership capabilities, and exceptional communication skills
. You are an objective and analytical professional capable of investigating complex conditions, developing defensible engineering opinions, and communicating those opinions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Structural, Architectural, or a related Engineering discipline from an accredited program; an advanced degree is considered an asset.
Licensed Professional Engineer (P.E.) in Florida, or ability to obtain Florida licensure within an agreed-upon timeframe.
Approximately 12+ years of progressively responsible engineering experience, with meaningful experience in forensic engineering, failure analysis, construction defects, insurance claims, existing buildings, structural systems, or building envelope investigations.
Demonstrated experience leading complex forensic investigations and developing technically supported opinions regarding causation, damage, failure mechanisms, standard of care, or repair requirements.
Strong technical expertise in one or more areas such as structural systems, building envelopes, roofing, waterproofing, façades, concrete, fenestration, water intrusion, construction defects, or storm-related damage.
Experience preparing forensic reports, expert opinions, technical analyses, and other defensible professional deliverables suitable for claims or litigation matters.
Prior experience providing deposition or trial testimony is strongly preferred; candidates with substantial forensic experience who are prepared to develop into an expert witness role may also be considered.
Working knowledge of applicable Florida Building Code requirements, construction practices, standards, and investigative methodologies relevant to the candidate’s areas of expertise.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical findings clearly, objectively, and confidently to attorneys, clients, opposing professionals, mediators, judges, juries, and other stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor technical professionals, manage complex assignments, exercise independent professional judgment, and maintain appropriate quality and documentation standards.
Ability to develop and maintain trusted relationships within the legal, insurance, property management, community association, and broader construction industries.
Unwavering commitment to professional ethics, independence, objectivity, technical excellence, accountability, and defensible engineering practice.
Valid driver’s license and ability to travel throughout Florida and occasionally beyond the region for investigations, meetings, depositions, mediations, and other assignments as required.

Maintain high standards for technical quality, responsiveness, professional ethics, financial performance, and defensibility of engineering opinions.

Strong technical expertise in one or more areas such as structural systems, building envelopes, roofing, waterproofing, façades, concrete, fenestration, water intrusion, construction defects, or storm-related damage.
Experience preparing forensic reports, expert opinions, technical analyses, and other defensible professional deliverables suitable for claims or litigation matters.
